T7.description: Bacteriophage T7 RNA polymerase promoter. Strongest bacterial promoter; requires T7 RNAP (e.g. BL21(DE3) strain). Inducible by IPTG.

trc.description: Hybrid trp/lac promoter. Strong constitutive/IPTG-inducible. Requires lacI repressor.

lac.description: Classic lac operon promoter. IPTG-inducible, weak without lacUV5 mutation.

araBAD.description: Arabinose-inducible promoter. Tightly regulated; repressed by glucose.

CaMV35S.description: Cauliflower Mosaic Virus 35S promoter. Constitutive, high expression in most dicots. Weak in monocots.
CaMV35S.sequence_note: Full-length 35S is ~946 bp; double 35S (d35S) gives 2x expression

FMV35S.description: Figwort Mosaic Virus 35S promoter. Constitutive; better monocot expression than CaMV35S.

Ubi1.description: Maize Ubiquitin-1 promoter. Strong constitutive expression in monocots (maize, wheat, rice). Preferred for biolistics.
Ubi1.notes: Often paired with Ubi1 intron for enhanced expression

NOS.description: Nopaline synthase promoter from A. tumefaciens. Weak constitutive expression in plants; mainly used for selectable markers.
